ents, the recommended dose of cyclobenzaprine is 5 mg three times a day. Based on individual patient response, the dose may be increased to 10 mg three times a day. Use of cyclobenzaprine for periods longer than two or three weeks is not recommended. (see INDICATIONS AND USAGE ). Less
